rationale: The most recent 1-minute candle expanded to a new session high on the highest volume of the last five bars and closed at its peak, lifting price above both session VWAP and the 9-EMA while the instrument sits at the 78th percentile of its daily range after a 6.55% gap and 6.29x relative volume.
